_source.title: 原理图 & 符号 / 引脚图元类
_source.remarks.text.0: 引脚图元仅符号编辑器可用，在原理图图页内，关联到符号的引脚被称为 {@link ISCH_PrimitiveComponentPin | 器件引脚图元}

title: Schematic & symbol / pin primitive class
remarks.text.0: Pin primitives are only available in the symbol editor. In a schematic sheet, the pin associated with a symbol is called {@link ISCH_PrimitiveComponentPin | a device pin primitive}
